app = Flask(__name__)

        return jsonify({"message": f"IP {ip_to_block} is already blocked"}), 409

    return jsonify({"message": f"IP {ip_to_block} has been blocked"}), 201

    # Proceed with normal request handling
    return jsonify({"message": f"Request to {path} received from {client_ip}"}), 200

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=5000)
